I just found this sub. I am an extremely active online user but I have yet to find a decent Maine community. I would like to see this grow. It would be awesome to have a vibrant and creative community with a focus on 'all things Maine.'

Does anyone have an actual plan to increase awareness? Is anyone promoting the sub? Are there any folks who actively check the sub? I am willing, and able, to contribute but I would much rather do so if I knew it would help. As someone who has come to Maine as a retiree, I am very fond of the area and could have chosen anywhere on the planet (within reason) to spend my time. I chose Maine and, I feel, I chose it for good reasons and have had excellent results.

I came here as a youth to attend school. I went to Kent's Hill. We had a hunting camp, still do I suppose, here. Being able to live here is a privilege and one that I greatly appreciate. It did take me a while to get accepted, I am "from away" so there is that. Once accepted it was full, complete, and welcoming. I am a bit eccentric and even that is accepted.

Anyhow, I shall start... Perhaps...

I am from up in the Rangeley area, outside of it, and I live in an unincorporated township. I hunt, fish, and grow a good portion of my food. I try to be an active citizen in my local community and often donate funds of volunteer my time when there is a call for it. My business, sold and happily retired, was traffic modeling. We modeled vehicular traffic and extended to include pedestrian traffic as well. As near as history can tell we were the first, or among the first, to do so 'on a computer.' My degree is in Applied Mathematics and I have a masters in Electrical Engineering.

I've been online since the mid 1980s, when we dialed BBS numbers and connected to single compute devices. Technology is a passion as is learning and, of course, maths. I have some hobbies that include history and writing. I have a bunch of land that used to belong to the paper companies (it was a steal) which I keep open for public access. As an import, from away, who am I to tell the locals that their traditions are to be hindered because I now have a piece of paper that insists I own the property? I may be 'from away' but most would not know it unless I told them.

I guess my question is really this... What can I do to help? How can I help the founders of this sub make this into something that they envisioned? What is it, specifically, that they want from this and how do they plan on getting there? If I am able to help and if my assistance is wanted then I am willing to do what I am able. I can not, and will not, moderate. I can, and will, bookmark this sub and add content if I know what types of content are wanted and as time allows.

The lack of activities posted, news, or discussions, from such an active state, is disheartening. I would like to see that change if that is what the goal of this sub is. It seems likely that the sub would want additional content so I am operating under that assumption for now. Maine is truly a four-season state (five if you count mud-season) with activities that span the calendar. There is something to do, somewhere, for everyone. (Yet the local kids decry the state as 'boring' and can not wait to graduate and leave. They will learn and return, I suspect.)

So, for such an active and interesting place, I feel, there could be a much more active sub though I have my doubts about how many Mainers are on this particular site. I expect it is a tiny proportion. I'd expect it to be a percent of a percent of the total users. That may be a problem. I do not think it is an unsolvable problem if it is, indeed, a problem.

Earlier today, I posted an article from the Sun Journal in News and that made the front page for quite a while. Of course, the topic was that Portland may opt to criminally charge the lady who recently made the false rape allegations but, still, it made the front page and that made me happy.

So, yeah, assuming that the current state of affairs here is a bit low-traffic and that the desire is more traffic then what is the game plan and where, if at all, do I fit in?
